questionText: In a Star network topology, all client workstation nodes are connected directly to:

options.text: A single shared linear backbone coaxial bus cable
A central network hub, switch, or router
Each other in a closed unidirectional circular ring
Every single other node via dedicated point-to-point links (full mesh)

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

topic: Data Frame Switching Flow Across Network
questionText:
Arrange the sequential operational stages of a network frame traveling from a source workstation through a Switch to a destination:
(A) Source host encapsulates IP packet into a Data Link frame containing source and destination MAC addresses
(B) Frame enters incoming physical switch port; switch reads source MAC and updates its internal MAC address lookup table
(C) Switch inspects destination MAC address and looks up the corresponding outbound port in its MAC table
(D) Switch forwards the frame exclusively out of the designated target port to reach the recipient workstation

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:
detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Switching sequence: encapsulation -> arrival and source learning -> destination lookup -> unicast forwarding.
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.
